label: O (BLIND: long, crowded histories; written after the set N fixes, before any run; run once; the final test)
description: SET O: long histories, the same design and question mix as sets M and N with new people. Three users with about 95 messages each over about 18 months: moves (one announced months before), job changes, other people with their own cities and jobs, similar trips, plans that change, many everyday questions, some on the same topics as the user's life. 57 questions: 12 current values, 7 past values, 11 episodes (one count), 4 details, 5 changed plans, 7 about other people, 5 indirect (3 scored by hand), 2 direct facts (one with three values), 1 trap and 3 abstain questions. Status: BLIND. Predictions: docs/predictions/set_O.md. All people, places and companies are new.
